name: nih-reporter-scraper
title: NIH RePORTER Grants Scraper – Federal Research Funding API
description: Search NIH grants via the official NIH RePORTER API: keyword, fiscal year, institute, activity code, org, state, PI, award-amount and award-date filters, plus an optional PubMed join. Auto-chunks past the 15k-row wall. Watch mode returns only what's new since last run. Science research grants API.
